select
    md5(cast(concat(coalesce(cast(silver.customer_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')) as string)) as customer_sk,
    silver.customer_id,
    silver.customer_name,
    silver.email,
    silver.city,
    silver.customer_status,
    silver.customer_creation_date,
    silver.source_created_at,
    silver.source_updated_at,
    silver.is_deleted,
    silver.silver_updated_at
from `ecommerce_analytics_poc`.`ecommerce`.`silver_customers` as silver

cross join (
    select max(silver_updated_at) as last_loaded_at
    from `ecommerce_analytics_poc`.`ecommerce`.`dim_customers`
) as watermark
where watermark.last_loaded_at is null
    or silver.silver_updated_at >= watermark.last_loaded_at - interval 6 hours

select
    md5(cast(concat(coalesce(cast(silver.order_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')) as string)) as order_sk,
    silver.order_id,
    case when silver.customer_id is not null
        then md5(cast(concat(coalesce(cast(silver.customer_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')) as string))
    end as customer_sk,
    silver.customer_id,
    silver.order_amount,
    silver.order_status,
    silver.order_date,
    silver.source_created_at,
    silver.source_updated_at,
    silver.is_deleted,
    silver.silver_updated_at
from `ecommerce_analytics_poc`.`ecommerce`.`silver_orders` as silver

cross join (
    select max(silver_updated_at) as last_loaded_at
    from `ecommerce_analytics_poc`.`ecommerce`.`fact_orders`
) as watermark
where watermark.last_loaded_at is null
    or silver.silver_updated_at >= watermark.last_loaded_at - interval 6 hours

with key_counts as (
    select
        customer_id,
        customer_sk,
        customer_creation_date,
        count(*) over (partition by customer_id) as customer_id_count,
        count(*) over (partition by customer_sk) as customer_sk_count
    from `ecommerce_analytics_poc`.`ecommerce`.`dim_customers`
)

select *
from key_counts
where customer_id is null
    or customer_sk is null
    or customer_creation_date is null
    or customer_id_count > 1
    or customer_sk_count > 1

with key_counts as (
    select
        order_id,
        order_sk,
        order_date,
        count(*) over (partition by order_id) as order_id_count,
        count(*) over (partition by order_sk) as order_sk_count
    from `ecommerce_analytics_poc`.`ecommerce`.`fact_orders`
)

select *
from key_counts
where order_id is null
    or order_sk is null
    or order_date is null
    or order_id_count > 1
    or order_sk_count > 1

with order_summary as (
    select
        customer_sk,
        count(*) as total_orders,
        count(case when order_status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 end) as completed_orders,
        cast(sum(case when order_status = 'COMPLETED' then order_amount else 0 end)
            as decimal(28,2)) as completed_sales_amount,
        count(case when order_status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 end) as cancelled_orders,
        count(case when order_status = 'REFUNDED' then 1 end) as refunded_orders,
        max(order_date) as latest_order_date
    from `ecommerce_analytics_poc`.`ecommerce`.`fact_orders`
    where is_deleted = false
    group by customer_sk
)

select
    customers.customer_sk,
    customers.customer_id,
    customers.customer_name,
    customers.city,
    customers.customer_status,
    coalesce(orders.total_orders, cast(0 as bigint)) as total_orders,
    coalesce(orders.completed_orders, cast(0 as bigint)) as completed_orders,
    coalesce(orders.completed_sales_amount, cast(0 as decimal(28,2))) as completed_sales_amount,
    coalesce(orders.cancelled_orders, cast(0 as bigint)) as cancelled_orders,
    coalesce(orders.refunded_orders, cast(0 as bigint)) as refunded_orders,
    orders.latest_order_date
from `ecommerce_analytics_poc`.`ecommerce`.`dim_customers` as customers
left join order_summary as orders
    on customers.customer_sk = orders.customer_sk
where customers.is_deleted = false

with customer_counts as (
    select
        customer_id,
        customer_sk,
        total_orders,
        completed_orders,
        completed_sales_amount,
        cancelled_orders,
        refunded_orders,
        latest_order_date,
        count(*) over (partition by customer_id) as customer_id_count,
        count(*) over (partition by customer_sk) as customer_sk_count
    from `ecommerce_analytics_poc`.`ecommerce`.`gld_customer_summary`
)

select *
from customer_counts
where customer_id is null
    or customer_sk is null
    or customer_id_count > 1
    or customer_sk_count > 1
    or total_orders is null
    or completed_orders is null
    or completed_sales_amount is null
    or cancelled_orders is null
    or refunded_orders is null
    or total_orders < 0
    or completed_orders < 0
    or cancelled_orders < 0
    or refunded_orders < 0
    or completed_orders + cancelled_orders + refunded_orders > total_orders
    or (completed_orders = 0 and completed_sales_amount <> 0)
    or (total_orders = 0 and latest_order_date is not null)
    or (total_orders > 0 and latest_order_date is null)
